title: GitLabCreateUserResponse
description: Response from gitlab for successful creation of a user

id.description: The unique ID of the user in gitlab

username.description: The username of the user in the actual gitlab instance.

locked.description: If the user has been locked

email.description: The email address of the user.

avatar.description: The URL of the avatar for the user profile.

organization.description: The organization name that this user belongs to.

identities.description: The list of identities linked to this user.
